title: I am making a game criticizing how AI is used: Spell Death
author: TheMarasligil
selftext:
Ok ok, it's not "Oh ai is bad".

It's more how we interpret and use it.

This is how the story goes:

Humanity was given the words, the true words with power. Babel fall, languages fractured as punishment to hubris. All but one word was lost.

That word kept on being uttered for centuries, never did humanity know how powerful it was.

Then, we invented more and more ease and convenience, and the word was used less and less.

Until one day it was lost.

And as it was lost, demons were found. They just, appeared. We were given gifts and more convenience, more vice and sin. They asked for ooone tiiiny thing: Stop reading and writing.

And we took the deal. 

Now, people scavenge the world for books, letters, invoices, anything with letters on it to exchange it for the sins offered by demons, which gets cozied in their host.

You, as a scavenger, found a lexicon - a big hit, bit no words in it: just empty pages. And with it, a deck of cards. You put the letters to spell fire for shits and giggles, as you are one of the last gen to remember literacy. 

A fire engulfs the landfill you found your haul on.

In the empty page, a sentence appears:

Find the word and spell death.

This is how you, the player, become the Lettercaster.

\-----

These demons are the conveniences and of course, AI. They are not here to eat, nor enslave. They wanna be fed. And this is how i imagine an overly used tool becomes proxy to what we are supposed to be. On top of that, from lust to greed, sloth to envy, ai is there, for now, as just the tool. But, who knows if they ll remove the middle man to feed us our sins and vices automated.

Game was created by me (ideation, gdd, game balance and whatnot)

Images, songs, code created by ai, edited by me (several thousand times and lines)

We will see the discussion - i am neither pro nor anti AI. As with everything, i am for moderation amd true labeling of the technology (as i was for ads in gaming, where we started adding ads to mobile games, they told us that s stupid and noone wil watch ads and here we are, rewarded videos amd interstitials are making billions of usd for mobile games)
